text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein examines new designs for Saddam's Grand Mosque to be built in Baghdad.
- Deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz continues contacts in New York.
- New chief of U.N. commission disarming Iraq under the 1991 Gulf War ceasefire says his task in Iraq is purely technical.
- Palestinians in occupied territories send a gift to Saddam.
- Hundreds of children gather at U.N. headquarters in support of Iraqi children.
- Iraq and Russia resume parliamentary talks.
(The above were also carried by JUMHOURIYA and AL-IRAQ)
- Editorial attacks Zionist crimes against Arabs and Moslems in occupied territories.
